decision: A time penalty of 5 seconds is imposed after the race (5 seconds added to elapsed race time). (2 penalty points awarded, 4 points for the 12 month period). Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 77 (Valtteri Bottas) and the team representative. The driver of car 77 admitted the collision was his fault, that he had completely misjudged the situation and that the braking of car 35 caught him by surprise and that he should have left more margin.
